info.syllabusName: Kết cấu bê tông cốt thép 2 (Reinforced Concrete Design 2)
info.description:
Reinforced concrete slabs: actions, design of one-way spanning slabs, two-way spanning slabs; flat slabs.

Continuous RC beams: elastic method, elastic with moment redistribution method.

Whole structure design: basics about dynamic of structures, wind load.

Deflection calculation.

Stairs.

Reservoirs.
info.decisionNo: Ban hành theo QĐ CTĐT TDTU

clos.loDetails: This course provides to the students the basic knowledges about the mechanical behaviour of reinforced concrete (RC) structures.
After this course, students can perform the structural design of RC structures: slabs, continuous beams, stairs, frames, walls, reservoirs, deflection calculation.
This course develops the skills of students in analyses, designs and expertise of RC elements.
